rewrites: Delete the pure, unused fannkuch(n) call in fannkuch2 (kernel.py:44). It returns a value discarded by the entry and mutates only locally allocated lists; the observable result is None for every successful input.

Represent None by a false public presence tag (CirC rejects a literal zero-length array) and preserve the original n=0 IndexError as an assertion failure. For 1<=n<=1024 the permutation enumeration terminates and has no externally visible effects.
notes: This rewrite removes no returned output: the declared entry is fannkuch2, not the helper fannkuch. Both full bounded native translations and their resource diagnostics are preserved under ungrouped.* and bounded.*.
